Name: Universal Love Dinoegg
Author: eggeggbig
Description:
文森特居然不喜歡恐龍蛋？這個小鎮居然只有4名居民喜歡恐龍蛋？
恐龍蛋是奇蹟的產物！我相信他能被孵化成巴的傳播！
這麼棒的東西應該更受喜愛！


所以我做了這個模組讓喜歡恐龍蛋！
不僅改變了喜好也增加了每個人
人恐龍蛋的反應有兩種！除了收到Penny我給了他五種！
（反應內容包括一些侏㑩紀公園的梗）


現在還在等什麼！
把兔子都賣掉改養恐龍吧！


記住！恐龍就是生命！恐龍就是愛！

Vincent doesn't like Dinosaur Eggs?! How can that be?! There are only FOUR villagers in this town who actually like Dinosaur Eggs?!

Dinosaur Eggs are a miracle of nature! I believe the fact that they can hatch is a blessing from Yoba!

Something this amazing deserves to be loved by everyone!

So I made a mod that makes everyone love Dinosaur Eggs!

Not only did I change everyone's gift preferences, but I also added unique reactions for everyone when they receive a Dinosaur Egg.

Two reactions per person! Except Penny, who gets FIVE!

(Some of the reactions include a few Jurassic Park references.)

So what are you waiting for?!

Sell all your rabbits and start raising dinosaurs instead!

Remember: Dinosaurs are life! Dinosaurs are love!
